highlights: Frontier AI models are advancing rapidly, with OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol and Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 delivering significant performance gains and cost efficiencies, making powerful AI more accessible for diverse applications.

The AI agent ecosystem is maturing, highlighted by Google Research's open-source RRSI for self-improving agents and NVIDIA's Open Agent Safety Platform, providing crucial frameworks for developing and securely deploying autonomous AI.

Multi-modal AI continues to expand its practical applications, exemplified by H Company's Holo4 enabling agents to interact across desktop and web, and Alibaba's Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime delivering advanced full-duplex voice interactions.

agents.title: Google Research Open-Sources RRSI: AI Agents That Improve Their Own Harness Without Overfitting
agents.summary: Google open-sourced RRSI, a framework enabling LLM agents to autonomously optimize their prompts, tools, and memory without altering model weights, leading to improved, generalized performance across new tasks. Builders can leverage this for more robust and adaptive agent systems.

agents.title: H Company Releases Holo4: Open-Weight Computer-Use Models That Click, Code and Call Tools Across Desktop, Web, Android and APIs
agents.summary: H Company launched Holo4, an open-weight family of generalist models that allow AI agents to directly control computers by clicking, typing, generating code, and calling APIs across desktop, web, and mobile, significantly expanding autonomous interaction capabilities for developers.

agents.title: Introducing dots
agents.summary: OpenAI introduced "dots," proactive AI assistants designed to manage complex projects and routine tasks autonomously, offering a new product category for intelligent automation where users maintain control while AI drives progress.

models.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
models.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol, offering near-Astra level intelligence for coding, computer use, and professional workflows at one-fifth the API token price, enabling developers to build highly capable applications more cost-effectively.

models.title: Anthropic Releases Claude Sonnet 5.5: 70.6% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 at the Same $2/$10 Price
models.summary: Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 delivers 30%+ faster output and enhanced performance on benchmarks, maintaining its competitive pricing, allowing builders to achieve up to 30% lower cost per task with increased efficiency for demanding applications.

models.title: Alibaba Qwen Releases Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime: A Full-Duplex Voice Model Trained to Think, Act, and Decide When to Speak
models.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team released Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime, a full-duplex voice model capable of reasoning, tool invocation, and autonomous speech timing, dramatically improving task success and reducing irrelevant replies for real-time conversational AI.

tools.title: NVIDIA Launches Open Agent Safety Platform
tools.summary: NVIDIA introduced the Open Agent Safety Platform, an open reference design featuring OpenShell for policy-based agent sandboxing and Sentry for millisecond-speed quarantine, providing critical infrastructure for secure and robust AI agent deployments.

tools.title: DevDay 2026 Recap
tools.summary: OpenAI's DevDay 2026 recap highlights over 20 announcements, including new GPT-6 Astra capabilities, advanced APIs, and security features, providing a broad suite of enhanced tools and platforms for developers to innovate on AI.

tools.title: Improving Medical Calculation of LLMs with Embedded Coding
tools.summary: The MedCode framework enhances LLMs' medical calculation accuracy by 20-30 percentage points by training them to generate executable code for arithmetic operations, offering a critical tool for developers building reliable AI in high-stakes healthcare applications.

companies.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
companies.summary: OpenAI's launch of GPT-6.1 Sol signifies a strategic move to offer near-Astra intelligence at significantly reduced costs, democratizing access to powerful AI for a wider range of enterprise and developer applications.

companies.title: DevDay 2026 Recap
companies.summary: OpenAI's DevDay 2026 showcased over 20 major announcements, including GPT-6 Astra and expansive updates to its ecosystem of APIs, security, and developer tools, cementing its leadership and fostering broader innovation across the AI community.

companies.title: Nebius Opens 2026 Physical AI Awards: Five $150K Compute Credit Prizes
companies.summary: Nebius, in collaboration with NVIDIA, launched the 2026 Physical AI Awards, offering five startups $150,000 in compute credits, promotion, and mentorship, demonstrating a significant investment in fostering innovation within the physical AI sector.

learning.title: Two years of OpenAI Academy
learning.summary: Celebrating two years, OpenAI Academy expands its global reach to deliver essential AI skills, underscoring OpenAI's commitment to empowering more communities with the knowledge and capabilities to build in the AI era.

learning.title: DevFest is back
learning.summary: DevFest 2026 returns with over 800 global events, providing developers with opportunities to connect, build, secure, and scale solutions, with a strong focus on the evolving "agentic AI era" to foster practical skills and community development.

learning.title: Working with AI: A Design Framework for Human-AI Collaboration
learning.summary: This white paper introduces a practical framework for designing effective human-AI collaboration in industrial settings, offering guidelines for organizations to successfully integrate AI, enhance productivity, and ensure human-centered adoption.
